{{Quote|I love Jedi. You're such reasonable people.|translated=1|Vistis Garn|<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />}}
'''Vistis Garn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Garn worked primarily for the criminal group known as the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]], but he would work for any organization that offered the right price. When he was hired by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate to [[Raid on a Republic Military warehouse|steal]] the design files of the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[Hero of Tython|former apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] pursued Garn to a Guild [[Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse|warehouse]] and defeated the thief. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] spared the Rodian [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] after interrogating him, and Garn fled to his friends on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Let's make a deal, huh? I have the data files, but the guild already decrypted them. I transmitted a copy to my clients. You want the people who hired me. I'll tell you where they are&mdash;if you promise to let me go.|translated=1|Vistis Garn|<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />}}
A [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Vistis Garn became an accomplished [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place in [[3643 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:TOR dates/1|here]].</ref> Garn was working part-time for the criminal organization known as the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], but he also freelanced for other organizations.<ref name="The Jedi Envoy">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Jedi Envoy|Coruscant}}</ref> Garn had been successful enough to draw the attention of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]], who maintained a case file [[Case File 1142-235-3721|#1142-235-3721]] on the Rodian and offered a reward for his arrest.<ref name="Case File #1142-235-3721">{{TORcite|type=message|Case File #1142-235-3721|Coruscant Security Special Investigation Panel}}</ref>

That same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]]&mdash;who was masquerading as a Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] named Eli Tarnis&mdash;hired the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate to steal the design files for the [[Planet Prison]], his own [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] project. While the Guild and Black Sun were rivals, Black Sun gave the job to Garn, who worked with a Guild team to [[Raid on a Republic Military warehouse|infiltrate]] a Republic [[Unidentified Republic Military warehouse|warehouse]]. Garn and his team&mdash;which consisted of two Rodian thieves, three [[Ongree/Legends|Ongree]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]], and an [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] guard&mdash;sliced into the building's [[Computer/Legends|computer]] network, stole the files, and escaped with a shipment of munitions, weapons, and [[Missile/Legends|rockets]], but not before Garn was seen briefly by a [[Security camera/Legends|security camera]]. Returning to the [[Old Galactic Market]]&mdash;the region under the Merchants' Guild's control&mdash;Garn and his team reported to a Guild [[Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse|warehouse]].<ref name="The Jedi Envoy" />

[[File:Vistis_hurt.png|thumb|left|300px|Vistis Garn after the fight]]
While Guild members unloaded the stolen weapons with the help of a [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]], one of the slicers decrypted the design files. As soon as the slicer finished, Garn secretly sent a copy to his employers in Black Sun. However, the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] had identified Garn on a security recording, and the [[Hero of Tython|former apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] was sent to recover both the files and the stolen weapons.<ref name="The Jedi Envoy" /> The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] companion, the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]], [[Raid on the Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse|stormed the warehouse]] and defeated the Guild members. Upon realizing the warehouse was under attack, Garn sealed himself inside the warehouse's secure room. Recovering the weapons, the Knight cut open the security door and confronted the criminal.<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />

{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Realizing that his enemy was a Jedi, Garn apologized and activated a quartet of [[Autoturret/Legends|autoturrets]] in an attempt to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Knight and T7. However, the pair were able to disable the turrets and disarm the Rodian without much trouble, and Garn quickly surrendered. Learning that the Knight was searching for the design files, he freely gave them to the Jedi and offered to give up the names and locations of his employers if the Knight would allow him to leave. The Jedi agreed, and let the Rodian depart in peace after learning that he had been hired by Black Sun. Thanking the Jedi and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]], Garn told them that he planned to go stay with friends on the [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler's]] [[Moon/Legends|Moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Whoa, whoa! I give up! I only work for the guild part-time. I'm not dying for them.|translated=1|Vistis Garn|<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />}}
Vistis Garn was a [[purple]]-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] Rodian male with [[Blue|bluish]]-purple skin. An accomplished thief who spoke [[Rodese/Legends|Rodese]], he worked for the highest bidder, and was never completely loyal to one side. He was more than willing to work for competing parties, evident when he worked for both the Migrant Merchants' Guild and their rival, Black Sun. Despite being a criminal, Garn also respected the Jedi, and was willing to accept mercy when it was offered, although this was because he was afraid after being defeated.<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Vistis Garn was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He appears in the Jedi Knight class mission "Stolen Secrets" on Coruscant, where the player is ordered to locate Garn and recover stolen weapons from a Merchants' Guild warehouse in the Old Galactic Market district. After being defeated, Garn can be either spared by the player for [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-side]] points or killed for [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] points.<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />
